svg.title: 6b. Sequence - turns 5 to 7: READY -> SERVED -> eating -> PAID, then the result after turn 18

g.text: 6b. Sequence - turns 5 to 7: READY -> SERVED -> eating -> PAID, then the result after turn 18
Turn 5: serve the dish that became READY on turn 4
a Critic would check for cold food
[still PREPARING, or became READY this turn]
Turn 7: Cashier (automatic, one per turn, oldest first)
